# netskopebwan_vpnpeer (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the VPN Peer.
- `ikev2` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ikev2))
- `ip_address` (String) Ip Address of the VPN Peer.
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `name` (String) Display name of the VPN Peer.

### Optional

- `ip_location` (Boolean) Indicates whether Ip Location is enabled
- `type` (String) type of the vpn peer

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `disabled_at` (String) Time object record was disabled in ISO 8601 format.
For example '2019-05-08T05:30:30.206Z'
- `id` (String) VPN Peer ID
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
